# sequence fixtures

- `basic.mmd`, `fragments.mmd`, `activations-notes.mmd`, `create-destroy.mmd` and parts of
  `participant-types.mmd` and `arrows-autonumber.mmd` follow the examples in the Mermaid
  documentation (https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/sequenceDiagram.html), MIT licensed,
  © Knut Sveidqvist and contributors.
- `runtime-sample.mmd` is the mermaid-svg 0.7.0 sample shipped in
  `crates/nana-ui-runtime/tests/fixtures/mermaid/sequence.mmd`, MIT licensed
  (https://github.com/xmiksay/mermaid/tree/v0.7.0/samples).
- `cjk-wrap.mmd`, `minimal.mmd` and `empty.mmd` are written for this engine: CJK labels,
  long labels that wrap, `<br>` breaks and the smallest inputs.
